input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for address, block, mining. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to interact with address functionality, so that I can accomplish my address-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with block functionality, so that I can accomplish my block-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with node functionality, so that I can accomplish my node-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with transaction functionality, so that I can accomplish my transaction-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use address capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
